title: exit_levers.since_entry returns the full pre-entry candle frame in the first bar after an entry (and drops the entry bar), so telemetry reports bars_held ~199 and a pre-entry peak_r; this fired a false stall wake on SLV pkg-3df9800bf7f04882 at 13:34Z
note: MEASURED 2026-10-29 ~14:44Z by manager on operator request: trade 6778 opened 13:32:37Z; 13:34Z packet bars_held 199 / peak_r -0.2355 / open_r 0.0 (stall wake); 14:41Z packet bars_held 1 / peak_r null (correct). Cause: since_entry line ~129 'filtered if len(filtered) > 0 else candles_df' + 'ts >= cutoff' excludes the entry bar. Lane also counts other false-stall wakes over 14 days. Side finding to report: slv_trend_1h on alpaca_paper rejected 10 of 11 orders since 2026-10-02 (journal ids 6393..6779).
